newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utilites to sell $500 mln trust pfd.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utilites to sell $500 mln trust pfd.

text.p: Texas Utilities Electric Co, the operating susbsidiary of Texas Utilites Co, plans to sell $500 million in trust preferred securities via Goldman Sachs & Co on Thursday, according to a company official.

The offering will consist of a $400 million in fixed-rate, 40-year trust preferred securities which are non-callable for 10 years, and $100 million in floating-rate, 40-year trust preferred securities, which are non-callable for five years. The floating rate tranch is indexed to three-month LIBOR.
A Texas Utilities spokesman said the company is considering increasing the size of the floating-rate tranch and decreasing the size of the fixed-rate tranch depending on invstor demand.
The securities will be issued from business trusts formed by Texas Utilities. The trusts are called TU Electric Capital IV and TU Electric Capital V.
